exposure: inadequate prenatal care (<3 visits to prenatal care facility)
outcome: pediatric hospitalization (across six distinct disease categories)
cohort: The study included 127,396 neonates born to Bedouin women with singleton pregnancies who delivered in a tertiary medical center in Israel between January 1, 1991, and January 1, 2014.
finding: Inadequate prenatal care correlated with reduced pediatric hospitalization rates among offspring for all morbidities other than cardiovascular ones, potentially due to lower healthcare service utilization.
